name: PILLAR
aliases: Mirabegron in patients aged 65 years or older
question: Does flexibly dosed mirabegron improve urgency incontinence and urinary frequency versus placebo in older adults with overactive bladder wet?

design.population: Community-dwelling adults aged at least 65 years with overactive bladder for at least 3 months, at least one incontinence and three urgency episodes over 3 days, and at least eight micturitions per 24 hours.
design.description: Multicenter, phase 4, double-blind randomized superiority trial
design.locator: Full text, Methods, pp 212–213; Full text, Table 1, p 215; Griebling 2020, Results and Table 1

verdictNote: Both coprimary 12-week diary endpoints improved versus placebo.
takeaway: In adults aged at least 65 years with overactive bladder wet, flexibly dosed mirabegron improved 12-week daily micturitions and incontinence episodes versus placebo; the primary report described both coprimary differences as statistically significant.

reports.label: Primary efficacy report
reports.citation: Wagg A, Staskin D, Engel E, et al. "Efficacy, safety, and tolerability of mirabegron in patients aged ≥65yr with overactive bladder wet: a phase IV, double-blind, randomised, placebo-controlled study (PILLAR)." *Eur Urol.* 2020;77(2):211-220. doi:10.1016/j.eururo.2019.10.002
reports.followUpLocator: Full text, Study overview and Assessments, p 212

results.measure: Change in mean micturitions per 24 hours from baseline to end of treatment
results.note: Adjusted mean difference, mirabegron minus placebo; endpoint data: 437/430 at baseline and 435/427 at end of treatment (mirabegron/placebo). Second in prespecified testing sequence.
results.locator: Full text, Analyses, p 213; Results, p 214; Figure 3 caption, p 216

results.measure: Change in mean incontinence episodes per 24 hours from baseline to end of treatment
results.note: Adjusted mean difference, mirabegron minus placebo; endpoint data: 437/430 at baseline and 435/427 at end of treatment (mirabegron/placebo). First in prespecified testing sequence.
results.locator: Full text, Analyses, p 213; Results, p 214; Figure 3 caption, p 216

results.measure: Change in mean volume voided per micturition from baseline to week 12, mL
results.note: Adjusted mean difference, mirabegron minus placebo; third in prespecified testing sequence; FAS-I 437 mirabegron and 431 placebo at baseline.
results.locator: Full text, Analyses, p 213; Results, p 214

results.measure: Change in mean PPIUS grade 3–4 urgency episodes per 24 hours from baseline to week 12
results.note: Adjusted mean difference, mirabegron minus placebo; FAS-I 437 mirabegron and 431 placebo at baseline.
results.locator: Full text, Assessments, p 212; Results, p 214

results.measure: Change in mean urgency-incontinence episodes per 24 hours from baseline to week 12
results.note: Adjusted mean difference, mirabegron minus placebo; FAS-I 437 mirabegron and 431 placebo at baseline.

results.endpoint: At least 50% reduction in daily incontinence episodes
results.measure: Patients achieving at least 50% reduction in incontinence episodes per 24 hours at week 12
results.note: FAS-I responder analysis; the article text gives rounded percentages without responder counts.
results.locator: Full text, Analyses, p 213; Results, p 215
